name: featured-five
selection_rule: Fix the original KC–T1 G2 case. In order, take one eligible game from LPL regional qualification (G2), Worlds play-in (G2), Worlds main Swiss round 1 (G1) and Swiss round 5 (G2). In each stratum, minimize overlap with previously selected teams, then choose the earliest UTC series, breaking ties by series ID. Include both phases. No labels or model scores participate.
